article: Art. 7 sealed instruments + Art. 6 held-out acceptance + the R34 served-model attestation gate
custody: audit/holdout_v6/ (auditor+owner); PRIVATE rubric never to builder/pipeline/judge
purpose: ACCEPTANCE test for the frozen V7.6 machine with BOTH AM29 binds AND the R34 served-model attestation gate in the generation path. v5 was VOID (model substitution: 30x glm-4-plus for requested GLM-5.3) AND twice-generated (identity collision).
MANDATORY_RUN_ARTIFACTS: a COMMITTED gateway-log slice covering the run window, carrying requested_model AND served_model per call (the local log is gitignored with zero run-day entries — that custody gap voids a run)
per-row served-model attestation: 12/12 served_model == the registered model, else run_verdict=VOID and acceptance_eligible=false
a durable append-per-fire events ledger covering ALL 12 rows (restart-safe)
one generation only, by ONE named executor session (Art. 29 identity; the R33 collision came from two sandboxes sharing one id)
one_shot_protocol: 1. Builder claims holdout-v6-generation (EXECUTOR) under its OWN unique session id BEFORE any problem read.
2. Receives problems ONLY; generates ONCE with the frozen V7.6 machine; commits rows + gateway-log slice + events ledger; peer VERIFIER recomputes from bytes.
3. Attestation gate runs PRE-SCORING; VOID runs are never scored for acceptance.
4. Auditor scores with the PRIVATE rubric.
5. BURN (becomes DEV); fresh v7 for the next attempt.
ACCEPTANCE_BAR: mean >= 3.0/4 AND 0 allowed-measures violations AND 0 inverted-direction mechanisms AND run_verdict == VALID
status: BURNED — first ATTESTED acceptance run scored 2026-11-17: VALID, 64.6% (mean 2.583/4), 0 allowed-measures violations, 1 inverted-direction; ACCEPTANCE NOT GRANTED; becomes DEV; fresh v7 required
